stage1.impression: A clean, legible CG shopfront: the Ember pair reads at a glance and the frame is dim without being crushed, but it is a showroom, not a place. The plaster and floor are cool grey and flat, the shelves are three-quarters empty, there is no glass between us and the room (no reflection, no street), and the pale plinth and the fogged lower cabinets pull the eye away from the drivers. A magazine would see a generic shop render, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The shopfront glass must be visible as glass: a faint reflection of the street lamp and the lit building opposite across 5 to 15 % of the frame, without hiding the pair
The plinth must read as the low black plinth: median luminance under 35 instead of 77
The room must look stocked and in use: shelves filled with records, a record out of its sleeve, glasses on the table and bar, a coat or bag, a person or the trace of one behind the glass
The plaster and floor must read warm under 2700 K (r_median at least 1.2 x b_median), not cool grey
The left plaster wall must stop being the brightest surface in the room after the speakers (now median 108, peaking at 159 behind the shelf)
The lower third of each cabinet must hold detail instead of a pink haze, so the ports and base read as cast acrylic
The concrete floor must show a scan texture at 1:1 (pour lines, sealer sheen, small marks), not a smooth even grey

defects.what: No shopfront glass reads: no reflection, no mullion, no dirt, so the window premise of the frame is lost and it looks like a cutaway of a room
The plinth reads as beige or pale oak (median 77, r 101 g 73 b 51), not black; it is the brightest flat surface under the pair
The left plaster wall is hot and cool grey (median 108, profile peaks at 159), a flat CG wall with no trowel texture; it competes with the speakers
The left shelves are almost empty (two stacks of records, a white card); reads as an unstocked showroom
The right shelves are sparse and repeat the same record spines
The floor is a smooth mid grey with a faint repeating plank-like pattern, too bright (median 84) and with no scan detail at 1:1
The lower cabinet on the left speaker is washed out in a pink veil; ports and base lose their edges
The same pink veil on the right speaker's lower cabinet
The horns have a single long specular streak and look like glossy plastic rather than thick polished resin
Ceiling and soffit are empty and flat; the three squares on the left wall read as placeholder panels
The foreground sill is a featureless band; at the bottom-left it reads as a dark slab rather than a window ledge or frame
The table and its two Hemispheres are dim and unpropped; no glass, no record, no sign of life
Fine uniform noise or grain at 1:1 over the walls and the drapes, consistent across tones, reads as added grain over a denoised render

changes.problem: The frame does not read as seen through a shopfront window: there is no glass in the picture.

evidence.measured: No reflected structure anywhere; dark ceiling band median 20 is uniform; no highlights from the street lamp

change.setting: street lamp outside, building opposite lit windows, the shopfront glass finish
change.from: street lamp 0.5 W/m2, building 0.3 lit, glass reading as absent
change.to: street lamp 2.0 W/m2 at 2200 K placed behind and left of the camera so it reflects in the upper-left glass; building opposite 0.5 lit; glass with a real Fresnel reflection and a faint dust or fingerprint layer on its surface

changes.expected: A soft warm reflection of the lamp and a few lit windows lies over the dark ceiling band and the drapes, lifting it by 5 to 15 levels in places, while the pair stays clear

changes.problem: The plinth reads pale beige instead of the black plinth, and draws the eye below the speakers.

change.setting: the plinth's finish, and the window pair's spots
change.from: light, satin finish under 2 x 150 W spots at 22 deg
change.to: blackened steel or black-stained oak finish, matte to low satin; window pair spots 110 W each, cone 18 deg, aimed at the woofers so the plinth top falls off

changes.expected: The plinth is near black with a soft sheen along its front edge; the speakers stand on a dark base

changes.problem: The shop looks empty and unsold: shelves mostly bare, no props, no sign of life.

evidence.measured: Left shelves: two short stacks of records, one white card, the rest empty; right shelves similar

change.to: records filling every shelf bay, a few face-out sleeves, price cards; two wine glasses and a record out of its sleeve on the table; a coat over the back of a stool; bottles and glasses on the bar

changes.expected: The shelves read as a stocked record shop; the room reads as a specific place mid-evening

changes.problem: The left plaster wall is overlit and is the brightest surface after the speakers.

evidence.measured: lum_median 107.6, falloff along y peaks at 158.8

change.to: 3 x 18 W, 26 deg, aimed lower onto the shelves' contents rather than the bare wall

changes.expected: The wall reads as a pool of warm light falling off into dark, median about 60 to 75

changes.problem: The plaster and the concrete read cool grey instead of warm under 2700 K, and the room looks like a grey showroom.

evidence.measured: floor right of the plinth r 78 g 69 b 67 (region 880,520,1080,700); left wall r 120 g 105 b 97

change.setting: materials: the plaster and the floor tint
change.to: plaster #8C7E6C (warmer, darker, with a visible lime-plaster trowel texture), floor #463E35 with more sealer sheen and the scan's pour lines kept visible

changes.expected: Walls and floor go warm brown-grey; the floor under the pair falls darker so the speakers lead

changes.problem: The floor in the foreground is too bright and flat, so the frame has no dark between its pools of light.

change.setting: the room's fill and the haze

changes.expected: Pools of light under each spot with dark floor between, floor median about 50 to 65

changes.problem: The lower cabinets are veiled in a pink haze that flattens the cast acrylic, and the horns' highlight reads plastic.

evidence.measured: lower cabinet visibly fogged in the crop; speaker region clip_pct 0.58 (left) and 1.15 (right)

change.to: exposure 3.3, AgX - High Contrast, with clamp 6 to tame the horns' streak

changes.expected: Deeper blacks inside the cabinets, ports and base edges legible, horn highlight shorter and less glossy; speaker median stays at 45 or more

changes.problem: The camera sits square to the window at standing height and shows a flat sill band, so it reads as a cutaway rather than a passer-by's look through the glass.

change.to: position [-2.6, 1.4, 1.5], 35 mm, target [2.4, 3.6, 1.15], a slight angle so a window mullion enters one edge and the glass reflection gains depth; keep verticals level

changes.expected: The pair still holds the centre, a mullion or reveal frames the left edge, and the sill reads as part of a shopfront
